name: package-validator
description: Reports outdated package.json dependencies of a GitHub repository, in the browser and by email

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/contracts --workspace api --workspace ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace api && npm run check --workspace ui
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm test --workspace api --workspace ui
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:contracts && npm run test:e2e --workspace api
